description: This is a satellite image depicting the Salines des Pesquieres in Southern France, captured in 2012 by Eurostat as part of the LUCAS (Land Use and Land Cover Area frame Survey) programme. The image displays a coastal area with a prominent system of salt pans (salines) forming a large blue and turquoise band between the sea and the inland landscape. The salines are visible as large, geometric, rectangular, and elongated ponds with varying shades of blue and green, indicating different stages of salt evaporation. To the south-east, the dark blue body of water represents the sea, featuring a coastal town with a developed port and urban infrastructure along the shoreline. Inland from the salines and urban areas, the landscape is characterised by reddish-brown rectangular patches, typical of agricultural fields, and more varied brown-green hues indicating natural or semi-natural vegetation and hills.
